description: This file defines a 'callout' node for a rich text editor, including its attributes, HTML parsing/rendering, commands, input rules, and node view for UI interaction within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: Callout
classes.description: A Tiptap Node extension representing a callout block with customizable type and collapsible UI.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Defines attributes for the callout node, including type and collapsed state, with HTML parsing and rendering logic.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Specifies the HTML tag ('div.callout') that represents the callout node.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Renders the callout node as a div element with class 'callout' and merged HTML attributes.

methods.name: addCommands
methods.description: Provides a command 'setCallout' to create or update a callout node with specified attributes, checking permissions.

methods.name: addInputRules
methods.description: Defines an input rule that converts specific text patterns into a callout node with appropriate type and content.

methods.name: addNodeView
methods.description: Creates a custom DOM node view for the callout, handling UI interactions like collapsing/expanding on click.
